findings.title: Preserve Pause and Delete for Prometheus-only list rows
findings.body: Every Grafana row in the new list now passes only promRule to RuleActionsButtons, but AlertRuleMenu still requires a Grafana rulerRule to render Pause and a defined rulerRule to render Delete. Consequently, both actions disappear from the grouped and filtered lists even for authorized users. The new Prometheus ability checks do not remove these rendering guards. Adapt the actions to use the identifier or load the ruler configuration on demand.

findings.title: Open the silence drawer for Prometheus-only rules
findings.body: The new Prometheus ability checks expose Silence notifications for Grafana list rows, but clicking it only sets showSilenceDrawer. The drawer still mounts only when rule is a Grafana alerting ruler DTO, whereas the new list supplies no rule at all. Thus clicking Silence notifications in the new list does nothing. Load the ruler rule when opening the drawer or support opening it from the Prometheus rule and identifier.

findings.title: Return disabled abilities when skipToken is supplied
findings.body: skipToken is converted to undefined, but useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities still marks Duplicate supported and allows it whenever the user has Grafana rule-create permission. AlertRuleMenu invokes this hook with skipToken for data-source rules and ORs its result with the ruler abilities. A user who can create Grafana rules therefore sees Duplicate for Mimir/Loki rules even without external-rule write permission or ruler support. Return unsupported/disallowed abilities for skipped rules instead of allowing the Grafana fallback to override data-source restrictions.

findings.title: Retain the federation check for combined-rule consumers
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously checked isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), but now delegates to this implementation, which hardcodes isFederated to false. The delegation discards source_tenants, and useIsRuleEditable receives only the source and rule DTO, so it cannot restore that group-level restriction. Existing combined-rule consumers now offer Update and Delete for federated Mimir groups that were previously treated as immutable. Preserve the federation information when delegating.

findings.title: Keep management abilities available for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: isAlertingRule is false for Grafana-managed recording rules, but it now gates ModifyExport, Pause, Restore, and DeletePermanently. The ruler-based implementation supported these actions for both Grafana alerting and recording rules. Since the new list has no ruler DTO to provide fallback abilities, recording rules immediately lose their Export menu despite sufficient read permission. Use the broader Grafana-rule check for management actions and reserve the alerting-only check for Silence.

findings.title: Preserve the originating list URL in rule-view links
findings.body: The replacement link drops the returnTo parameter that GrafanaRuleLoader previously populated with createReturnTo(). Opening a rule from a filtered list therefore no longer supplies the originating URL to the viewer's return navigation, causing it to fall back to the default list rather than preserving the filters. Include the returnTo parameter in this link as before.
